subject.title: fix(copilot): keep tool transcript groups structurally complete

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new fail-closed Copilot transcript policy, which drops an interrupted or unwriteable assistant/tool-result group and marks native replay invalid rather than retaining partial audit data?
rationale: The implementation can enforce either structural validity or partial audit retention, but choosing the operator-facing failure semantics and upgrade policy is a maintainer product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept complete-group fail-closed persistence
options.body: Merge after real-run proof and owner review, accepting that incomplete groups are omitted to keep the canonical transcript structurally valid.

options.title: Preserve partial audit records
options.body: Redesign the transcript model to retain an explicitly invalid partial group, with a documented replay boundary and migration-safe reader behavior.

options.title: Pause for narrower policy design
options.body: Keep the PR open until Copilot and session owners define the durable audit contract for interrupted tool calls.

recommendation.title: Accept complete-group fail-closed persistence
recommendation.body: Merge after real-run proof and owner review, accepting that incomplete groups are omitted to keep the canonical transcript structurally valid.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the active author of the affected Copilot transcript implementation, though independent current-main ownership provenance could not be established here.
